text: There He broke the flaming arrows, The shield, the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
You, even You, are to be feared [with the submissive wonder of reverence]; Who may stand in Your presence when once You are angry?
For the wrath of man shall praise You; With a remnant of wrath You will clothe and arm Yourself.
He will cut off the spirit of princes; He is awesome and feared by the kings of the earth.
